snippet.title: SOLACE CREEK | Midsummer Night's Scream: A HORROR GAME AWARDS SHOWCASE 2026
snippet.description:
Solace Creek is a PSX-stylized horror mystery set in the lonely Teraset Station. Haunted by a monstrous presence, with six mysterious red coins, you embark on a tense and deliberate journey. A faithful to the classics retro-inspired horror title with a focus on exploration, atmosphere & puzzle solving.---
Originally aired during MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Monday 1 June 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
